item.title: State commission releases new report on racial injustice throughout Illinois history
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Ill. (WCIA) -- A first-of-its-kind report was released this week by the state commission formed to research Illinois' role in past racial injustice. The Illinois African Descent-Citizens Reparations Commission (ADCRC) released on Friday its report titled “Taking Account: A History of Racial Harm & Injustice Against Black Illinoisans."
